target_game: fantasy RPG with a Three.js/Vite renderer
poly_target: up to 3000 triangles — smooth balloons need more geometry than a typical low-poly asset
material_style: MeshStandardMaterial with roughness 0.05–0.35 (shiny latex), metalness 0.0 — balloons are glossy rubber, NOT matte
size_reference: asset should fit inside a 2×2×2 unit bounding box
technique_notes: LOW-POLY STYLE: prefer IcosahedronGeometry(r, 1–2) per balloon — keep faces faceted, avoid over-subdivision
Each balloon is a SEPARATE mesh with ONE solid vertex color per balloon (not noise-based variation)
Balloon shape: slightly elongated sphere — scale Y by 1.15–1.25 to make teardrop shape, small pinch at bottom
UV coordinates are required — use spherical projection for each balloon sphere
Vertex color per balloon: pick from a diverse palette (red, green, blue, orange, yellow, magenta, teal, purple, white, dark-green). Apply the same color to every vertex on that balloon.
Strings: thin CylinderGeometry or custom lines from bottom of each balloon converging to a single point below
Set roughness 0.08–0.25 and metalness 0.0 explicitly on every balloon — shiny latex, never matte
Balloons clustered into a tight 3D bunch — overlapping, at varying heights and depths

camera_basis.world_x: image right — objects at positive X appear to the right of the render
camera_basis.world_y: image up — objects at positive Y appear higher in the render
camera_basis.world_z: image depth — positive Z goes INTO the screen (further from camera)

derived_rules: Bunch hangs in the air: balloon centres between y=0.1 and y=1.6, strings dangle below (y<0)
Cluster is roughly centred at x=0, z=0 — balloons spread in all directions (X, Y, Z)
No group.rotation — geometry is already in correct orientation for this camera

expected_arrangement.description: 9 balloons loosely clustered in a tight 3D bunch — rigid sticks hold them at similar heights

count_and_identity.notes: Nine distinct balloons on rigid white sticks. User confirmed count=9.

shape_and_proportions.silhouette_description: a group of overlapping circles forming a rounded mass

attachment_and_connection.connector_description: Rigid white sticks, one per balloon, going straight down from the balloon bottom. Sticks do NOT converge to a single point.

surface_and_material.color_description: green, blue, red, purple, yellow, orange
